_note: Spec-faithful AGB Layer 1. Three element classes (concept, thin_instance, measure_element). Thin instances carry ONLY identity+provenance; attribute/measure VALUES are NOT here (Q39/Q43). Numbers you want to display live in the separate 'demo_display' cache below, which represents what Layer 2 would federate at query time — it is deliberately kept outside the graph elements.

build_model.principle: Rows/registry anchors -> nodes; descriptive columns -> folded (NOT nodes); numeric columns passing the measure test -> measure_element nodes; events materialise on demand.

element_classes.concept: type-level node, one per entity/event type regardless of row count (Q39).
element_classes.thin_instance: identity only: entity_type + source_key + label + provenance pointer. NO attributes, NO measures, NO dates (Q39). An index, not a copy (Q43).
element_classes.measure_element: a numeric business quantity promoted to its own element so relationships can point at it (Q68). Carries a definition + summable flag; VALUES federate via Layer 2, never stored (Q43).

faithful_notes: Instance->concept membership is the thin instance's entity_type FIELD, not an edge (Q39's 'provenance pointer to its type') — so no INSTANCE_OF edge flood; concept shown as a node for the class to be visible.
Relationship edges keep type+endpoints; their numeric properties moved to demo_display (they are values).
Values that a demo wants to show (penalty $, tons, dates, counts) are in demo_display, representing the Layer 2 federation result — NOT Layer 1 content.

layer2_federation.description: At query time components 07/08 fetch values from source via Layer 2 source-mappings. Layer 1 supplies identity, topology and semantics only (Q43).

not_nodes.routed_to: multi-valued attribute on Manifest (and rolled up on SHIPS_TO)
not_nodes.reason: Q63 multi_valued_unparsed / Q58 attribute — a code carried on a row is an attribute of the event, not an entity with its own registry. Queried by federating the manifest's waste_codes attribute at Layer 2.
not_nodes.was_wrongly: a WasteCode node type (13 column-value nodes) in the previous graph

not_nodes.routed_to: descriptive attribute on the Enforcement event
not_nodes.reason: Q58 attribute set — a category label on an event row is an attribute of that event.
not_nodes.was_wrongly: an EnforcementType node type (5 column-value nodes) in the previous graph

not_nodes.routed_to: descriptive attribute on the Violation event
not_nodes.reason: Q58 attribute set — a category label on an event row is an attribute of that event.
not_nodes.was_wrongly: a ViolationType node type (9 column-value nodes) in the previous graph

not_nodes.column: address / city / zip / lat-long / status / submission_type
not_nodes.routed_to: descriptive attributes on their parent Facility / Manifest node
not_nodes.reason: Descriptive columns describe an anchor; they never anchor their own entity.
